about: A1 II 4.00 reference data for reading an a1m2read dump; from cpapp-b.bin and build/emu_drvparam.py a1m2_400

screen_words.note: VDF fit mode for a 16:9 picture on a 3:2 panel (table for picture code 2, entry for panel code 1): 3 letterbox to 0 fill. The rear screen then shows the squeezed 16:9 live view over the whole 3:2 panel, i.e. stretched x32/27 vertically [A7 IV 0x1e4bcc, A7C II 0x1f8f4c]

cpActAfWindow (focus area frames), check 0x128530: expected live-view rectangle for a 16:9 picture on the rear panel, x, y: stock letterbox (0, 38, 640, 404) to the whole panel (0, 0, 640, 480) [A7 IV 0xd7b5a0]
